verdict.rationale: Slack documents workspace data export tools (slack-docs-22/23/35/36), but a hands-on community report describes being denied normal export access — 'Slack does not allow business customers to export their chats... only if your company has legal or compliance requirements and Slack approves the request' (slack-comm-8) — meaning export is gated/approval-only rather than a self-serve open-format export a user can freely invoke to 'leave'. There's also no evidence of open, non-proprietary export formats or full data portability (attachments, full history) comparable to open standards. Missing for 10: self-service unrestricted export for any user/plan, documented open file formats, independent confirmation of successful full data export without vendor gatekeeping.
